@@ -1,6 +1,8 @@
 {
   "comments": { "blockComment": ["{{!--", "--}}"] },
   "//": "No brace `brackets` on purpose. FlatBars has three brace widths — {{ }} (interpolation), {{{ }}} (raw), {{{{ }}}} (raw block). A `[\"{{\",\"}}\"]` bracket makes VS Code's bracket-pair colorization split `{{{` into a coloured `{{` + a leftover `{` (and auto-closing re-fires on every `{`). Brace structure/colour comes from the engine lexer + the TextMate grammar, which treat each opener (`{{`, `{{{`, `{{{{`, `{{#`, …) as ONE token — so we leave `brackets` empty rather than let the editor re-tokenize braces. Only string pairs auto-close.",
+  "//colorizedBracketPairs": "Explicit empty list disables VS Code's bracket-pair colorization for this language. Without this override, the editor's global `editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled` falls back to the default bracket set ({}/[]/()) and rainbow-colors EACH brace inside `{{{{` as a separate pair — turning a single quad-brace cluster into four differently-coloured tokens. The TextMate grammar treats every cluster as one `punctuation.section.embedded.*` span; this keeps colorization in step with that.",
+  "colorizedBracketPairs": [],
   "autoClosingPairs": [
     { "open": "\"", "close": "\"" },
     { "open": "'", "close": "'" }
